trip.level: beginner moving into lower-intermediate (carried estimate, unverified)

top_3.headline: Accommodation is the only urgent item
top_3.detail: Mid-January is peak Japan powder season and Myoko's Western-friendly slopeside inventory is small. 22 August is inside the normal booking window, not ahead of it.

top_3.headline: Myoko has published almost nothing for 26/27
top_3.detail: Only Suginohara has dates. The official Mt Myoko ticket shop lists zero products. Historic early-bird cut-off is 30 November, sales open around October.

top_3.headline: Escape Myoko has published 26/27 lesson prices
top_3.detail: JPY 30,000-59,000 per instructor per session, so JPY 15,000-29,500 each for two people. The only Myoko school that can be budgeted accurately today.
